faq.q: Is "Ladner Elementary" an official City of Delta neighbourhood name?
faq.a: No — it is a Paragon sub-area name that follows Ladner Elementary School (5016 44 Ave., confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file); the planning area is Ladner under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: If I buy in this sub-area, will my kids automatically attend Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: Not automatically — SD37 catchments are address-based. The district publishes the Ladner Elementary catchment boundary in its Ladner Area catchment maps (elementary and secondary, updated October 2017) — a document-based source, not a locator run — and the locator result recorded in this program for the school's own address, 5016 44 Avenue, is Ladner Elementary with Delta Secondary; every home address must still be checked.

faq.q: Which bus serves Arthur Drive near the schools?
faq.a: TransLink route 609 runs between South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road, serving the Ladner Elementary and Delta Secondary area, and route 601 runs South Delta to Bridgeport Station via Ladner Exchange.

faq.q: Are suites allowed on single detached lots here?
faq.a: Yes, where the zone allows — the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use, Delta's SSMUH zoning updates allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots, and the amendments also cover coach houses and garden suites; confirm the lot's zone on the City zoning maps.
